versions.changelog:
Agentic AI Clothing Designer 1.0.0 – Initial Release

- Launches a powerful tool for generating customized clothing designs for POD and MOD, covering a broad range of garment types.
- Supports natural language prompts, structured parameters, and reference images for detailed and flexible design input.
- Enables placement of personalized text, graphics, and logos, with automated multi-view and 3D interactive previews.
- Provides manufacturing-on-demand integration and supplier discovery via the Craftsman Agent platform.
- REST API available for draft generation with extensive customization options.
